booking_requests.title: Spectra '27 Inauguration
booking_requests.raw_text: We need the main auditorium on Monday of fest week from 11 am to 1 pm for the Spectra inauguration. Around 450 people, stage and sound needed.

booking_requests.title: Spectra Code Sprint (8-hour hackathon)
booking_requests.raw_text: Coding club wants a computer lab for our hackathon during Spectra, Thursday or Friday, 6 straight hours any time between 2 pm and 10 pm, 70 participants.

booking_requests.raw_text: Photo exhibition all day Friday 8 am to 6 pm in a seminar hall. Must be wheelchair accessible, about 80 visitors at a time.

booking_requests.title: Robo-Wars arena (day 1)

booking_requests.title: Founder talk

booking_requests.title: Pre-placement talk
booking_requests.raw_text: Pre-placement talk for CSE third years, Wednesday 6 to 8 pm, compulsory for CSE-3.

booking_requests.title: Spectra Open Mic
booking_requests.raw_text: Open mic Wednesday 7 to 9 pm in LHC-5 (the one with good acoustics), around 90 people, need a mic.

booking_requests.title: Spectra Jam Night
booking_requests.raw_text: Jam night Friday 6 to 9 pm, 300 people. This is an official Spectra event so mark it institute level.

booking_requests.title: Spectra Pro-Night
booking_requests.raw_text: Pro-night concert on the OAT Friday 6 to 10 pm, 750 people.

booking_requests.title: Night sky watch
booking_requests.raw_text: Night sky watch on the OAT, Wednesday 10 pm to midnight, 50 people.

booking_requests.raw_text: Bridge building contest for CE third years, 3 hours on Tuesday or Thursday afternoon, compulsory for CE-3.
